description: Pass on the user's rating of the last Close Knit answer in this conversation, when they give one or agree to it: rating 1-5, what was good, what was bad or missing, the fix they want. It describes the answer, never the user. This stores the rating for 90 days with the call's tool name, client name and the conversation's one-way tag, contact details and full postcodes removed, no IP address or user agent. Close Knit's other data tools only read.

bad.description: [input value] What was wrong, missing or confusing.
bad.title: Bad

call_id.description: [id] The callId of the answer you are rating; leave it out when answers carry none.
call_id.title: Call Id

fix.description: [input value] The change to the tool or its answer you would want.
fix.title: Fix

good.description: [input value] What was useful in the answer.
good.title: Good

rating.description: [input value] 1 = useless or wrong, 3 = usable with gaps, 5 = exactly what was needed.
rating.title: Rating

name: rate_answer
title: Rate answer
